title: The Lightning Harvesters' Truce
logline: Two estranged veteran gas-skimmers must unite to ground a floating refinery during a violent ion storm where their shared foster daughter is trapped.

roles.description: Veteran atmospheric storm flyer; brooding, stubborn, refusing to speak to his former flight partner for a decade.
Daring gas-cloud skimmer; sharp-witted, bitter, holding a ten-year grudge over a shattered ship partnership.
The independent union of storm pilots harvesting energetic plasma and noble gases from upper atmospheres.
A massive atmospheric processing platform suspended in the turbulent upper cloud layers of a gas giant.
A high-altitude tether station supplying specialized lightning arrestors and heavy ceramic couplings.

public_situation: Storm alarms wail across {role:floating_refinery} as severe ion turbulence threatens to ignite ungrounded gas collection bladders.
private_truth: {role:senior_skimmer} and {role:rival_skimmer} severed their flight partnership ten years ago, but their shared foster child is the junior engineer trapped on the burning refinery deck.

beats.public_change: Refinery sirens broadcast an emergency plea for outside heavy haulers as lightning strikes shatter primary grounding cables.

missions.reason: Collect heavy dielectric ceramic grounding couplings from the supply depot before upper atmospheric downdrafts close the descent corridor.
missions.private_fact: He abandoned the refinery deck earlier today after a bitter shouting match with his former partner, unaware their foster child was on shift.

beats.public_change: Electrical discharges arc continuously across the refinery's helium condensers as the squall intensifies.

missions.reason: Purchase reinforced tungsten-core grounding wire from the depot and deliver it to the platform's lower anchor pylon.
missions.private_fact: She mortgaged her skimmer ship to buy the wire because the refinery board refused to release emergency funds.

beats.public_change: A superbolt strikes the upper gas dome, welding the main grounding clamp shut and threatening a total platform explosion.

missions.reason: Deliver the manual emergency shunt breaker directly into the refinery maintenance hangar through gale-force shear winds.
missions.private_fact: The two pilots agreed over emergency comms to split the dangerous descent, each holding one stabilizer tether.

player_choice.prompt: The shunt breaker is docked and both pilots hold the refinery steady in the squall. They face the choice of how to settle their decade-long division.

options.label: Persuade both veterans to formally reconcile and re-register their joint storm salvage charter
Allow the rival skimmer to claim sole credit for the salvage bounty to clear her heavy ship mortgage
Turn the platform over to the guild salvage authority, leaving both pilots with modest safety stipends

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the shunt and facilitates the partners' joint grounding maneuver.
resolutions.summary: The refinery is saved. {role:senior_skimmer} and {role:rival_skimmer} reconcile their flight partnership, securing their foster daughter's future.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot flew between two feuding storm flyers to ground a burning gas platform in the upper atmosphere.

resolutions.reached_by: The rival claims sole credit and uses the award to pay off her ship lien.
resolutions.summary: {role:rival_skimmer} claims the municipal bounty, clearing her debts while {role:senior_skimmer} quietly retires from storm flying.

resolutions.reached_by: The salvage claim is assigned to guild trustees.
resolutions.summary: {role:harvesters_guild} takes direct administrative control of the refinery. Both pilots receive modest pensions, but their partnership remains broken.

resolutions.reached_by: The grounding cables fail or the descent is abandoned.
resolutions.summary: Lightning breaches the gas bladders. {role:floating_refinery} burns in the clouds, forcing an evacuation and leaving both {role:senior_skimmer} and {role:rival_skimmer} ruined.

loose_threads.detail: A high-interest ship mortgage registered by a cloud trading bank names both pilots on the original title deed.
The tungsten grounding wire spools carry export seals from an unlisted deep-cloud industrial syndicate.
Atmospheric gas futures dipped twelve percent before the storm hit, prompted by heavy short sales from a station factor.

radio_hooks: Atmospheric monitoring stations issue emergency gale warnings across upper gas giant flight bands.
Harvesters guild alerts independent pilots to catastrophic lightning discharges near cloud refineries.
Specialized ceramic grounding components sell out across orbital supply depots.

voice_direction.senior_skimmer: Deep, taciturn, and defensive. Speaks in slow, reluctant monosyllables and refuses to discuss the past or show sentiment.
voice_direction.rival_skimmer: Fast, cutting, and fiercely protective. Speaks with barbed sarcasm that slips whenever her foster daughter is mentioned.
